summary: Eight connected Fuhan campaign source-context repairs: retain existing AD346 one-sided bounds and make their narrative basis explicit. Partial uninstalled proposal; no date approval.

sourceDate.text: 季龍復遣其將劉渾…; 季龍聞而歎 (s0549, s0559, Fuhan campaign after Chonghua’s s0499 accession)

after.event: Shi Hu, styled Jilong, again sent Liu Hun with twenty thousand men to join Ma Qiu at Fuhan, then sighed that the nine provinces were exhausted there.

changes.reason: s0549 季龍復遣 explicitly renews Shi Hu’s own dispatch activity in the ongoing siege introduced at s0544, continuing his orders against Chonghua in s0504 and s0531. s0559 聞而歎 responds to the failure just described at Fuhan, so the lament belongs to this living military sequence. Chonghua’s accession in s0499 supplies the existing onOrAfter AD346 floor. His later reported death is a separate notice and contributes no endpoint or exact year here.

sourceDate.text: 季龍復遣其將劉渾等率步騎二萬會之 (s0549 during the post-s0499 Fuhan siege)

after.event: Shi Hu sent general Liu Hun with twenty thousand foot and horse to join Ma Qiu at Fuhan.

changes.reason: s0549 names Liu Hun as the general dispatched with twenty thousand foot and horse to join Ma Qiu at the Fuhan siege. 會之 links his movement directly to Ma Qiu’s forces in s0547, within the campaign after Chonghua’s s0499 accession. Liu Hun owns the military participation; the sending ruler’s dates do not substitute for his own. The existing onOrAfter AD346 floor is supported, while no exact dispatch year or upper endpoint is stated.

sourceDate.text: 郎坦…教軍士李嘉潛與秋通; 璩戮李嘉 (s0550–s0552, Fuhan siege after s0499)

after.event: Lang Tan instructed soldier Li Jia to communicate with Ma Qiu; Zhang Qu later executed Jia.

changes.reason: s0550 names Li Jia as the soldier whom Lang Tan instructed to contact Ma Qiu and bring enemy troops onto the wall. s0551 repels that breach; s0552 names Li Jia again as the man executed by Zhang Qu. This is Li Jia’s own connected collusion and death within the current Fuhan siege after Chonghua’s accession at s0499. The existing onOrAfter AD346 bound covers the attested acts without certifying an exact year or an unstated latest endpoint.

This immediate battlefield advice is Li Wei’s own activity, not an ancient quotation. Chonghua’s s0499 accession places the command and battle onOrAfter AD346; no exact battle year or upper endpoint is supplied.

The source supports the existing onOrAfter AD346 floor through Chonghua’s s0499 accession, but no exact maneuver year or upper endpoint.
